current_blocker_summary: Shift 96 source inspection proved the DIR-023 primitive defect in pinned go-apfs-v2 v0.3.0: CreateContainer resolves FixedTime into builder.timestamp and volumeSuperblock writes it to FormattedBy.Timestamp, but never assigns apfsSuperblock.LastModTime. The struct field exists and maps to reader VolumeSuperblock.ModificationTime at offset 256. v0.3.1/main has the same omission, so a dependency upgrade does not fix it. Next action is an evidence-backed mechanism to set LastModTime (upstream/fork or safe post-write checksum-preserving patch) before rerunning E2E; metaCryptoKeyOsVersion remains a separate proven mismatch.
